scope: Descriptive frozen-policy locked-recipient exposures. Multiple recipients/source and multiple discards/game are dependent. Bootstrap resamples entire source games and recomputes per-exposure means. No model fitted; observed category conditioning is post-discard, not a next-tile predictor. Sparse cells and multiple comparisons are exploratory.

batches.scope: Locked recipients only, all actual opponent discards including misses; features computed before discard; observed category is post-hoc conditioning, not a forecast of the next tile. Income labels source-ID matched after round. No fitting.
